content.text: Name one notable recent development in Rust programming language tooling.

choice.text: One notable recent development is **RustRover 2026.2**, which added endpoint discovery and route-to-handler navigation for **axum** projects, along with support for the **Ferrocene** qualified Rust toolchain.[12]
